wsjHeadlines.title: Stock Market Today: Investors Digest Apple Earnings; Nasdaq Falls
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil slides amid signs U.S., Iran could consider diplomacy

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic Investors Push for Cautious Valuation Closer to $1.5 Trillion
wsjHeadlines.description: Institutional investors who plan to buy shares in the AI company’s planned IPO show concern following a selloff in tech stocks.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Tumbles, but Stocks Fail To Launch
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Marvell makes a big acquisition and gets punished

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures See Modest Pick-Up
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures rose after three straight weeks of declines.

wsjHeadlines.title: Trump Family-Linked Mining Venture Aims to Go Public in $2 Billion Deal
wsjHeadlines.description: The firm that will become Kaz Resources has secured letters of interest for up to $1.6 billion in U.S. funding, drawing scrutiny from Sen. Elizabeth Warren.

wsjHeadlines.title: This Bond Measure Says Stocks Are Cheap. Don’t Believe It.
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus, Apple’s back on top.

wsjHeadlines.title: Netflix Needs You to Watch, Not Just Pay
wsjHeadlines.description: The streamer’s ad ambitions depend on viewing hours, which have stalled.

wsjHeadlines.title: Investors Are Betting a Blue Wave Will Help Hospitals. Don’t Count on It.
wsjHeadlines.description: Markets are anticipating a reversal of Trump’s Medicaid cuts. That may be easier said than done.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Market Isn’t Buying Skydance’s Balance-Sheet Math
wsjHeadlines.description: The media conglomerate’s goodwill alone exceeds its stock-market value.

wsjHeadlines.title: Alphabet Still Has the Ingredients to Win in an AI Pullback
wsjHeadlines.description: The tech giant is no longer loved by investors, despite its many advantages.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Boom Drives a Jump in Lending, but Bankers Still Sound Cautious
wsjHeadlines.description: Big and regional banks alike are riding a wave of AI lending.

wsjHeadlines.title: Anthropic’s ‘Adjusted’ Profit Exposes Wall Street’s Earnings Game
wsjHeadlines.description: The AI developer’s losses were the flip side of the big gains for Amazon and Alphabet.

wsjHeadlines.title: BOE Expected to Join Peers in Raising Key Rate
wsjHeadlines.description: The bank  is expected to join its peers in raising borrowing costs Thursday, with the Fed, ECB and BoJ having each raised rates at least once since start of U.S.-Iran war.

wsjHeadlines.title: NatWest Shares Fall After Bank’s Interest Income Guidance Disappoints
wsjHeadlines.description: The British high-street bank’s shares dropped after it forecast weaker-than-expected interest income next year.

wsjHeadlines.title: ING Launches Buyback But Flags Job Cuts and Unit Restructuring
wsjHeadlines.description: The Dutch bank launched a new buyback program of $1.84 billion and set out plans to restructure its wholesale banking unit.

wsjHeadlines.title: Societe Generale Posts Profit, Revenue Increase in Third Quarter
wsjHeadlines.description: The lender reported third-quarter net profit that beat market expectations despite a volatile macroeconomic backdrop in its home country.

wsjHeadlines.title: UBS CEO Signals Possible Switzerland Exit Over Capital Demands
wsjHeadlines.description: The group is caught in a dispute with lawmakers in its home country over proposals to introduce more demanding capital requirements on its foreign subsidiaries.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Stocks Mixed as Percolating AI Fears Offset Oil Relief
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. stocks ended mixed after hopes for U.S.-Iranian negotiations caused a slide in the price of oil, while concerns about a potential AI bust weighed on the technology sector.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Treasury, European Bond Yields Fall as Oil Prices Drop
wsjHeadlines.description: Yields on Treasurys and European government bonds fell as oil prices dropped sharply on renewed diplomatic efforts to end the conflict between the U.S. and Iran.

wsjHeadlines.title: Tech, Media & Telecom Roundup: Market Talk
wsjHeadlines.description: Find insight on DoorDash’s agreement to buy Instacart , Marvell’s Lumentum deal and more in the latest Market Talks covering technology, media and telecom.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oracle Looks to Raise $20 Billion to Fund AI Ambitions
wsjHeadlines.description: The software company is selling $10 billion in common stock and $10 billion in bonds, according to separate filings with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Morning Risk Report: Binance Resumes Withdrawals After Suffering Biggest-Ever Crypto Hack
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus: Former BizJet salesperson admits to bribing Latin American officials, and what does the Weil Gotshal implosion mean for the law industry?

wsjHeadlines.title: Dow Rebounds After Friday’s Selloff as Oil Slides
wsjHeadlines.description: Tech stocks’ early Monday gains are starting to slip away, despite a slide in oil prices.

wsjHeadlines.title: European Indexes Open Mostly Lower as Healthcare Stocks Slide
wsjHeadlines.description: European stock indexes were mostly lower at the open, as investors recalibrated after last week’s strength.

wsjHeadlines.title: AI Investors Are Racing to Get Insurance on the Biggest Market Bet in History
wsjHeadlines.description: With trillions of dollars riding on the artificial-intelligence trade, investors, traders and even tech executives are hunting for high-stakes protection.

wsjHeadlines.title: The Tangled Web of AI Bets Is Reason to Fear Tech Stocks
wsjHeadlines.description: Vendor financing is back in a new form and it magnifies the AI trade on the way up—and down.

wsjHeadlines.title: Wall Street Is Starting to Call the Shots in America’s AI Build-Out
wsjHeadlines.description: Lenders and investors are getting choosier about their bets and demanding stricter terms, as the AI build-out enters a new phase.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | A Sports Bet by Any Other Name Is Still a Bet
wsjHeadlines.description: The CFTC has neither the competency nor statutory authority to regulate gambling.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | An AI Halloween Market Scare
wsjHeadlines.description: Crypto isn’t risk-free after all, as thieves take Binance for $6.3 billion.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s IPO Will Be a National-Security Win for Taiwan
wsjHeadlines.description: Reliance on the island for AI chip production puts it among America’s top foreign policy interests.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | How Do Investors Measure ‘Social Impact’?
wsjHeadlines.description: Developing a common standard would be one of the best ways of expanding economic opportunity.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | When Is a Sports Bet Not a Sports Bet?
wsjHeadlines.description: Prediction markets like Kalshi are fundamentally different from sportsbooks and offer public benefits.

wsjHeadlines.title: Opinion | Anthropic’s Big IPO Gamble
wsjHeadlines.description: The company says it could save humanity or destroy it. Investors, place your bets.

wsjHeadlines.title: Oil Futures Sell Off on Middle East Diplomatic Progress
wsjHeadlines.description: Oil futures posted their biggest one-day percentage decline since July as diplomatic efforts toward direct peace talks between the U.S. and Iran subtracted risk premium from the market.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold Futures Recover Some Ground on Oil-Price Drop
wsjHeadlines.description: Gold futures started the week and the month higher with optimism about diplomatic efforts to end the U.S.-Iran conflict sending oil prices into a tailspin.

wsjHeadlines.title: Prediction Markets Keep Whiffing on Elections. Will They Miss on the Midterms?
wsjHeadlines.description: Polling data remained at issue after the recent Brazil, Serbia and Wisconsin elections markets were upset by supposed long shots.

wsjHeadlines.title: U.S. Natural Gas Futures Fall on Mild Weather Outlook
wsjHeadlines.description: U.S. natural gas futures settled lower, falling for a third consecutive week as the first significant cold weather of the season has yet to show up.

wsjHeadlines.title: Gold and Silver Futures Fall to 1-Year Lows
wsjHeadlines.description: Precious metals futures fell as conflicts in the Middle East and Russia-Ukraine push oil prices higher, fueling concerns about inflation and higher interest rates.

wsjHeadlines.title: Sterling Could Fall if BOE Dampens Rate-Rise Bets
wsjHeadlines.description: Sterling rose against a weaker dollar and fell against the euro. The BOE is likely to push back against elevated interest-rate expectations Thursday, leaving the pound exposed, Ebury said.

wsjHeadlines.title: Binance Heist: ‘Welcome to Our World,’ CISOs Say
wsjHeadlines.description: Plus: What went wrong at Binance; airline breach widens; cyber stocks drop
